This plot is for beans, not maize, so I will not waste my fertilizer coupon here — if I get FISP this year, the fertilizer goes on the maize plot where it matters most. Beans make their own nitrogen from the soil, that is what my father taught me. I will save some seed from last harvest like I always do, and my wife and I can manage the weeding ourselves on such a small piece. Money is tight, so no pesticide and no hired hands unless something unexpected happens.
